answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Cask stamper ash stave mark entered in the vat house book is the proof, and the price is each ash stave is an iron hoop pressed beside the coopers mark, so a farm must stamp. A clone costs 104 POA to mint and 16 minutes to prove; 704 clones cost 73216 POA and 11264 minutes to keep. The ocean is the evidence, the glacier is the expense, and the ember is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
